title: GenAI Engineer
description: Designs and builds applications powered by generative AI models. Works with large language models, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and integrating generative AI APIs into products using Python and cloud platforms.

title: Agentic AI Engineer
description: Builds autonomous AI agent systems that plan, reason, and execute multi-step tasks. Works with LLM orchestration frameworks, tool-calling, memory systems, and Python to create self-directed AI workflows.

title: MLOps Engineer
description: Manages the deployment, monitoring, and scaling of machine learning models in production. Builds CI/CD pipelines for ML, works with model versioning, containerization, and cloud infrastructure.

title: LLMOps Engineer
description: Specializes in deploying, monitoring, and optimizing large language models in production environments. Manages inference costs, latency, model versioning, and prompt pipelines at scale.

title: Prompt Engineer
description: Designs and refines prompts to optimize large language model outputs for specific business applications. Works closely with product teams to test, evaluate, and iterate on AI-generated responses.

title: AI Research Engineer
description: Conducts applied research on machine learning and deep learning architectures. Implements and evaluates novel model architectures using Python, PyTorch, and TensorFlow.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Builds and deploys machine learning models into production systems. Works across the full ML lifecycle from data preprocessing to model serving using Python and cloud ML platforms.

title: Data Scientist - Generative AI
description: Applies statistical and machine learning techniques with a focus on generative models. Builds and evaluates LLM-based solutions for business use cases using Python and NLP tools.

title: Conversational AI Developer
description: Designs and builds chatbots and voice assistants powered by natural language processing and large language models. Works with dialogue systems, intent recognition, and conversational design.

title: AI Product Manager
description: Leads product strategy for AI-powered features and applications. Bridges technical AI teams and business stakeholders, defining requirements for machine learning and generative AI products.

title: Computer Vision Engineer
description: Builds systems that interpret and process visual data using deep learning. Works with image recognition, object detection, and computer vision frameworks like OpenCV and PyTorch.

title: NLP Engineer
description: Develops systems that process and understand human language using machine learning. Builds text classification, sentiment analysis, and language model applications using Python and NLP libraries.

title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
description: Designs and maintains the compute infrastructure required to train and serve large-scale AI models. Works with GPU clusters, distributed training, and cloud infrastructure.

title: RAG Systems Engineer
description: Builds retrieval-augmented generation systems that combine large language models with external knowledge bases. Works with vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search.

title: AI Safety Engineer
description: Works on identifying and mitigating risks in AI systems including bias, hallucination, and misuse. Develops evaluation frameworks and safety guardrails for deployed AI models.

title: Full Stack AI Developer
description: Builds end-to-end AI-powered applications spanning both frontend interfaces and backend machine learning integrations. Works with React, Python, and AI APIs.

title: Data Engineer - AI Systems
description: Builds and maintains data pipelines that feed machine learning and AI systems. Works with ETL processes, data warehousing, and large-scale data infrastructure.

title: Cloud AI Engineer
description: Deploys and manages AI and machine learning workloads on cloud platforms. Works with AWS, Azure, or GCP AI services, managed ML pipelines, and scalable model serving.

title: AI Ethics Specialist
description: Evaluates AI systems for fairness, bias, and ethical compliance. Works with data science and product teams to ensure responsible AI development and deployment.

title: Synthetic Data Engineer
description: Designs systems that generate synthetic training data for machine learning models. Works with generative models and data augmentation techniques to improve model training.

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description: Integrates security practices into DevOps pipelines. Automates security testing, vulnerability scanning, and compliance checks throughout the software development lifecycle.

title: Platform Engineer
description: Builds and maintains internal developer platforms that streamline software delivery. Works with infrastructure as code, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tooling.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description: Ensures the reliability, availability, and performance of production systems at scale. Works with monitoring, incident response, automation, and cloud infrastructure.

title: Cloud Solutions Architect
description: Designs scalable cloud infrastructure solutions for organizations. Works across AWS, Azure, and GCP to architect secure, cost-effective, and resilient systems.

title: Kubernetes Engineer
description: Specializes in container orchestration using Kubernetes. Manages deployment, scaling, and operations of containerized applications in production environments.

title: Blockchain Developer
description: Builds decentralized applications and smart contracts on blockchain platforms. Works with Solidity, Web3 libraries, and distributed ledger technologies.

title: Web3 Engineer
description: Develops decentralized applications and protocols for the Web3 ecosystem. Works with smart contracts, blockchain infrastructure, and cryptocurrency wallet integrations.

title: Data Analytics Engineer
description: Builds analytics pipelines and dashboards that turn raw data into business insights. Works with SQL, data visualization tools, and business intelligence platforms.

title: Analytics Engineer
description: Transforms raw data into clean, tested datasets for analytics use. Works with SQL, data modeling tools, and modern data stack technologies.

title: Growth Engineer
description: Builds and experiments with product features focused on user acquisition and retention. Combines software engineering with data analysis and A/B testing.

title: Developer Experience Engineer
description: Improves internal tools and workflows that make software engineers more productive. Works with build systems, CI/CD, and internal developer platforms.

title: Edge AI Engineer
description: Deploys machine learning models on edge devices with limited compute resources. Works with model optimization, quantization, and embedded systems.

title: Quantum Computing Engineer
description: Develops algorithms and applications for quantum computing systems. Works with quantum programming frameworks and hybrid classical-quantum systems.

title: AR/VR Developer
description: Builds immersive augmented and virtual reality applications. Works with 3D engines, spatial computing, and interactive experience design.

title: Technical Product Manager - AI
description: Manages the roadmap and delivery of technical AI products. Works closely with engineering teams to translate business needs into AI-powered features.

title: AI Solutions Consultant
description: Advises organizations on implementing AI and machine learning solutions to solve business problems. Bridges technical capability with business strategy.

title: ML Platform Engineer
description: Builds internal platforms and tooling that enable data scientists to train and deploy machine learning models efficiently at scale.

title: Data Privacy Engineer
description: Implements technical safeguards to protect user data and ensure compliance with privacy regulations. Works with encryption, anonymization, and data governance tools.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst - AI Systems
description: Monitors and protects AI systems and infrastructure from security threats. Works with threat detection, vulnerability assessment, and incident response specific to ML pipelines.

title: API Integration Engineer
description: Designs and builds integrations between software systems using APIs. Works with REST, GraphQL, and third-party service integrations including AI APIs.

title: No-Code/Low-Code Developer
description: Builds business applications using no-code and low-code platforms, often integrating AI features without extensive custom programming.

title: AI Trainer/Annotator Lead
description: Leads teams that create and validate training data for machine learning models, including reinforcement learning from human feedback workflows.

title: Voice AI Engineer
description: Builds voice recognition and speech synthesis systems. Works with speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and conversational voice interfaces.

title: Recommendation Systems Engineer
description: Designs and builds personalization and recommendation engines. Works with collaborative filtering, embeddings, and large-scale ranking systems.

title: Search and Ranking Engineer
description: Builds and optimizes search and information retrieval systems. Works with semantic search, vector embeddings, and ranking algorithms.

title: Data Governance Specialist
description: Establishes policies and standards for data quality, security, and compliance across an organization's data systems.

title: Technical Writer - AI/ML
description: Creates documentation, tutorials, and technical content explaining machine learning systems, APIs, and AI products for developers and end users.

title: AI QA Engineer
description: Tests and validates AI and machine learning systems for accuracy, reliability, and edge-case behavior before production deployment.

title: FinOps Engineer
description: Manages and optimizes cloud spending across an organization. Works with cost analysis tools, cloud billing, and infrastructure efficiency.

title: Digital Twin Engineer
description: Builds virtual replicas of physical systems for simulation and monitoring, combining IoT data, 3D modeling, and predictive analytics.
